title: Utility Services Program Rate Schedule, Part A: Services Billed and Metering by Program
content:
# Utility Services Program — Part A: Services Billed and Metering by Program

Each apartment home carries one program of the Utility Services Program, and the program is the one that matches how the apartment home is metered. The table below states, for every program, the metering it corresponds to, which services are billed through the program, and how water and sewer are billed.

## A.1 Metering that fixes the program

| Program | Metering of the apartment home |
|---|---|
| Essentials Utility Plan | no resident utility meters |
| Water-Sewer-Trash Allocation Plan | a community master meter |
| Submetered Water Plan | a water submeter |
| Submetered Water & Gas Plan | water and gas submeters |
| Submetered Water, Gas & Electric Plan | water, gas and electric submeters |
| All-Inclusive Utility Package | water, gas and electric submeters |

## A.2 Services billed through the program

"Yes" means the service is billed through the program; "No" means it is not. For water and sewer, "No" means the resident contracts with the city directly.

| Program | Water and sewer | Trash | Pest control | Stormwater | Natural gas | Electricity |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Essentials Utility Plan | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Water-Sewer-Trash Allocation Plan | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Submetered Water Plan | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Submetered Water & Gas Plan | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Submetered Water, Gas & Electric Plan | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| All-Inclusive Utility Package | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## A.3 How water and sewer are billed

| Program | Water and sewer billing method |
|---|---|
| Essentials Utility Plan | none (not billed through the program) |
| Water-Sewer-Trash Allocation Plan | allocation |
| Submetered Water Plan | submeter |
| Submetered Water & Gas Plan | submeter |
| Submetered Water, Gas & Electric Plan | submeter |
| All-Inclusive Utility Package | package |

## Reading the schedule

- Two programs share the same metering: an apartment home with water, gas and electric submeters corresponds both to the Submetered Water, Gas & Electric Plan and to the All-Inclusive Utility Package.
- Natural gas is billed only on the Submetered Water & Gas Plan, the Submetered Water, Gas & Electric Plan and the All-Inclusive Utility Package; electricity only on the last two.
- Trash, pest control and stormwater are billed through every program.

*Example (hypothetical apartment home):* an apartment home with a water submeter and no gas or electric submeter falls under the Submetered Water Plan; its water and sewer are billed by submeter, and its gas and electricity are not billed through the Utility Services Program.
